# Supplementary information

### Hu

Authors’ associated Hu.csv dataset; 2361 data rows. Columns siRNA, mRNA, label, y, td are preserved verbatim, including serialized td feature vectors. No formal CSV data dictionary or thermodynamic units were supplied. These are associated repository CSVs, rather than a separately published supplement. Each row is one source record; td is stored as a quoted CSV cell containing comma-separated feature values. Neither td order nor physical units are authoritatively defined in the CSV.

[Hu](../assets/supp_table/hu.csv)

Source: Hu.csv.
